name: AutoEdit
description: A first cut of talking footage: transcribes (built-in Whisper), removes the hesitations it wrote down (French list: euh, heu, hum, ben, bah…; an « eux » only when it stands alone between pauses), then the silences. One undo step per stage, reported in the status bar. Whisper omits or mis-spells some hesitations: only written ones are cut by word. List: parameters fillers / also / conditional of transcript.removeFillers.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Montage auto (français)
entries.description: Transcribe in French, remove the French hesitations (euh, heu, hum, hmm, ben, bah… and an isolated « eux »), then the silences of 0.4 s or more (keeping 0.08 s of air).

entries.label: Montage auto (français, « eux » toujours coupé)
entries.description: As above, but cuts every « eux », isolated or not: whisper-base often writes a spoken euh as eux. A real eux (pour eux) is cut too, so check the result.

entries.label: Montage auto (anglais)
entries.description: Transcribe in English, remove um / uh / erm / hmm, then the silences of 0.4 s or more.

entries.label: Retirer les hésitations (transcription existante)
entries.description: Removes the filler words from an already transcribed sequence (the list follows the transcript's language: French or English).
